title: Polymorphic area calculation
description: Create an abstract class Forma with an abstract method calcularArea(). Then create Circulo(radio) and Cuadrado(lado) that implement calcularArea(). Use a Forma array to calculate areas polymorphically.
hints: Forma is abstract; it cannot be instantiated directly
Each shape calculates its area differently
The Forma array enables polymorphism: each element runs its own version
solutionExplanation: Polymorphism resolves which calcularArea() to execute at runtime.

title: Animal sounds
description: Create an abstract class Animal with an abstract method hacerSonido(). Implement Perro, Gato and Vaca. Then create a static method that receives an Animal and makes it produce its sound. Use instanceof to show additional information according to the type.
hints: instanceof checks the real type to show additional info
The Animal array allows polymorphic iteration
solutionExplanation: Polymorphism plus instanceof enables differentiated behavior without losing generality.
expectedOutput:
Rex says: Woof!
  It's a loyal dog
Michi says: Meow!
  It's an independent cat
Lola says: Moo!
  It's a calm cow

title: Payment processing
description: Create an abstract class MetodoPago with an abstract method procesar(double monto) that returns boolean and calcularRecargo(double monto) that returns double. Implement TarjetaCredito (3.5% surcharge), Transferencia (no surcharge) and PayPal (2.0% surcharge). Create a static method procesarPago that receives a MetodoPago and an amount, uses polymorphism to process it, and shows the surcharge and total. Use instanceof to show additional information.
hints: metodo.procesar(monto) uses polymorphism to run the correct version
instanceof lets you add specific info for each payment method
solutionExplanation: Polymorphism runs the correct version of procesar() and calcularRecargo() according to the real type. instanceof adds specific info without losing the generality of the array.
